Controller Avatar Animations v0.1

Instructions:
----------------- Place the animations in your vnyan>items>animations folder
- In Vnyan Settings > misc, scroll to the bottom and turn on capture gamepad. Restart the program
- Set the Grey "Camera 1" node to whatever your default stream camera is- Set the Grey "Camera 12" node to a camera centered and zoomed out enough to capture your full character
- Set the Green "Y" button filters to whatever (it plays the Green animation node)
- Set the Yellow "Right Shoulder" button filters to whatever (it plays the Yellow animation node)
- Set the Cyan "Right Trigger" button filters to whatever (it plays the Cyan animation node)
- The Black animation node controls your running animation
- The default coloured animation node controls your idle animation
Right click on the cyan Websocket Node and send signal to start! 
To stop the effect, right click the cyan Websocket Node and send signal again.

Optional:
----------------
Tweak the degree to witch your thumbstick movement affects your char by adjusting the operation values in the red/blue parameter operation nodes below!
